# Parser corpus skips

The normalized parser corpus is generated by `cmd/corpusgen` from
`testdata/upstream/css-parsing-tests` (see `testdata/upstream/css-parsing-tests/SOURCE`).

Two `component_value_list.json` cases are intentionally skipped because the
upstream corpus was written against the 2021 CSS Syntax 3 definition, which
treated U+0080 and U+0081 as identifier code points. The pinned specification
restricts the "non-ASCII ident code point" ranges, so the expected
tokenization differs.

The declaration-value whitespace divergence is normalized by
`cmd/corpusgen` and no longer skipped: current CSS Syntax 3 discards leading
and trailing whitespace in declaration values, while the 2021 corpus kept it.
